Midnight-blue background and warm metallic-gold graphic shapes, elegant art deco editorial typography, stylized gold saxophone, rooftop terrace railing and distant city skyline under a starry night sky. Sophisticated flat illustration, strong visual hierarchy, excellent legibility, generous margins inside story safe zones. Include exactly these event words, arranged on separate lines in a beautiful balanced layout: 'rooftop jazz', '24 October 2027', '7 pm', 'atlas roof', 'free entry'. Title large in upper half, details clearly readable below, saxophone and skyline in lower third. No other words, no invented logos, no watermark. The event date is 24 October 2027 wherever shown.
